images.encoding: WebP quality 90 (cwebp 1.6.0, -q 90 -metadata none), original dimensions, no crop or compositing
images.capture: Live 1.5.0 web UI of the installed Fedora package, rendered on the host in headless Chromium 149.0.7827.55 (Playwright 1.61.1), viewport 1289x864 at DPR 2 (2578x1728 px), native Linux platform, through the read-only route: every host-origin non-GET aborted, websockets closed; the two anonymous public GETs api.github.com/repos/papi-ux/polaris/releases/latest and /releases let through (Accept and User-Agent only); every other foreign request aborted. Theme chosen in the throwaway browser profile only (localStorage polaris-theme); no host config writes from the browser. Captured while Control Ultimate Edition streamed to a Retroid Pocket 6 running Nova. For the capture the paired client's name was changed from its test name to "Retroid Pocket 6" through the host API and restored afterwards; its pairing certificate was unchanged.
images.updatePill: v1.5.0 current (green); title "Update Center: v1.5.0 current. Latest v1.5.0-beta.2"
images.disclosure: The route card's client line showed the client's LAN address. That text was neutralized to "Local network" in the browser page before capture, the label neutralization the site capture script's --replace option documents. Nothing else in the image was changed.
